descriptionByLocale.it:

• Condurre un'analisi approfondita dei rischi legati ad ALM e al rischio di liquidità, identificando potenziali vulnerabilità e sviluppando strategie di mitigazione

• Monitorare la posizione di liquidità giornaliera dell'azienda, garantendo il rispetto dei requisiti normativi e interni in conformità con il framework di Basilea e l'ordinanza FINMA

• Collaborare con i dipartimenti del tesoro e della finanza per ottimizzare le pratiche di gestione della liquidità, inclusa la previsione dei flussi di cassa, la gestione del buffer di liquidità e le strategie di finanziamento/piano di contingenza

• Valutare e gestire l'esposizione dell'azienda al rischio di tasso di interesse nel banking book (IRRBB), sviluppando strategie per mitigare impatti negativi sui guadagni e sul capitale

• Condurre test di stress sulla liquidità e analisi di scenari per valutare l'impatto di condizioni di mercato avverse sulla posizione di liquidità dell'azienda

• Preparare rapporti dettagliati e accurati sul rischio di liquidità e ALM per la direzione senior, il Comitato, i Regolatori, fornendo un'analisi chiara e raccomandazioni

• Capacità di lavorare sotto pressione in un ambiente dinamico stabilendo priorità e rispettando scadenze ristrette

• Competenze Tecniche: Conoscenza avanzata di ALM e rischio di liquidità, strumenti e metodologie di gestione del rischio di tasso di interesse, inclusa l'analisi di scenari e i test di stress

• Competenze Analitiche: Eccellenti capacità analitiche e attenzione ai dettagli, con la capacità di interpretare e sintetizzare grandi volumi di dati complessi utilizzando conoscenze di programmazione (Python, R, SQL)

• Competenze Comunicative: Forti capacità comunicative scritte e verbali, con la capacità di presentare informazioni tecniche in modo chiaro e conciso a stakeholder non tecnici

• Esperienza: Almeno 3 anni di esperienza nella gestione del rischio, con particolare attenzione ad ALM/rischio di liquidità o al dipartimento del tesoro

• Lingue: Conoscenza madrelingua di italiano/inglese, francese/tedesco è un plus

• Certificazione professionale in gestione del rischio (ad es. FRM, PRM) è un plus

• Residente in Ticino o disponibile a trasferirsi
descriptionByLocale.en:
Description

The selected candidate will be responsible for managing risks related to the Active-Passive Management (ALM) and liquidity risk, ensuring that the company maintains a sound financial position and can effectively address market challenges.

Tasks

- Conduct an in-depth analysis of the risks related to ALM and liquidity risk, identifying potential vulnerabilities and developing mitigation strategies - Snap the company's daily liquidity position, ensuring compliance with regulatory and internal requirements in accordance with the Basel framework and the FINMA order - Collaborate with the Treasury and Finance Departments to optimise liquidity management practices, including cash flow forecasting, the management of buffer liquidity and financing strategies/quota plan -

Assessing and managing the company's exposure to interest rate risk in the banking book (IRRBB), developing strategies to mitigate negative impacts on earnings and capital - Conduct stress tests on liquidity and scenario analyses to assess the impact of adverse market conditions on the company's liquidity position - Prepare detailed and accurate reports on liquidity risk and ALM for the senior management of the Tehran, the Committee, regulators, providing a clear analysis and recommendations - Ability to work under pressure in a dynamic environment setting priorities

and respecting limited deadlines

Technical competence

descriptionByLocale.en:
Reporting to the Head of IT Audit, you will be a key technical expert within the internal audit team. You will be operating in a bank where technology represents a key pillar of the business strategy, with a strong focus on the in-house development of proprietary banking solutions. Your primary mission is to conduct in-depth, risk-based audits across our modern and complex technology landscapes and evaluate IT risks, security controls, and regulatory compliance (FINMA). A central part of your role will be to actively pioneer the future of our audit function by developing and integrating advanced methodologies that leverage data analytics and agentic AI. For this role, we are seeking a hands-on IT Auditor with a strong background in the financial industry and a passion for technology and innovation. Swiss Domicile is mandatory.

• Execute and Lead IT Audit Engagements: Take an active role in planning, executing, and reporting on risk-based audits covering information technology, infrastructure, data privacy, and information security.

• Audit Modern Technology Landscapes: Perform in-depth assessments of IT processes, risks, and controls within a cutting-edge environment (AI, cloud, CI/CD pipelines), critically evaluating the design and effectiveness of the internal control system.

• Shape Audit Strategy: Contribute your IT and security expertise to the risk-based audit planning process, helping to define key areas of focus and strategic priorities.

• Enhance Audit Methodologies: Drive the modernization of our audit approaches by developing and integrating advanced techniques using data analytics and leveraging AI-driven tools to enhance audit effectiveness, increase assurance, and automate testing.

• Collaborate on Joint Audits: Lead or assist in integrated audits with the business audit team and manage co-sourced audit engagements with external partners.

• Support Ad-Hoc Projects: Work independently on ad-hoc assignments and special projects as required by management.

• Education & Certifications: A Bachelor's or master's degree in ICT or equivalent. A professional certification such as CISA, CISM, or CISSP is highly desirable, as is a commitment to obtaining one.

• Core Experience: 4+ years of hands-on experience in a technical capacity (e.g., IT Audit, IT Security, IT Risk Management, or IT Compliance) within the Swiss financial industry.

• Frameworks & Regulations: Strong knowledge of IT audit methodologies and frameworks (e.g., COBIT, ISO 27001, NIST) and a solid understanding of the Swiss regulatory landscape, or the willingness to rapidly develop this knowledge.

• Data & AI: Relevant experience with data analytics tools (e.g., Python, SQL, Power BI), combined with the ability to develop and apply AI-driven solutions in an audit context, or a strong willingness to develop this capability.

• Language Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both Italian and English are required. German language skills are a plus.

• Key Competencies: Strong interpersonal and communication skills, the ability to explain complex technical issues to non-technical stakeholders, effective team collaboration, a capacity for rapid learning, and high adaptability to change.

• Travel: Availability for travel approximately up to 10% within Switzerland and also abroad.
